status: Eight exported files pass size, RGB, bit-depth and exact opposite-edge equality checks. Contact sheet and all eight 2x2 repeats visually inspected. Unity/import/in-game tests not run.
limitations: Tile edge equality is validated but gameplay zoom/repetition acceptance requires Unity scene integration.
Sources generated at 1254px were resampled to the contracted 2048px; upsampling does not add native painted detail.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game seamless texture tile, one square 2048x2048 RGB image filled edge to edge. Deep rich emerald and olive moss meadow turf, fine natural grass tufts and damp muted dark soil between broad moss patches; calm fine distributed detail, no flowers. Strictly 2D hand-painted classical Chinese wuxia earth-and-ink style, fine natural brushwork. Unless explicitly FRONT-ON, ground surface viewed orthographically at 36.87 degrees above horizon with depth detail foreshortened to 60%, 16 metres of screen-plane surface. Warm late-afternoon upper-left highlights softly painted into material, cool lower-right shading but NO object shadows or broad directional lighting gradient. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges. Even low-contrast distribution with no dominant unique feature, no border, no vignette, no horizon, no paths, no paving, no buildings, no flowers, no text or watermark. Rich verdant moss and wet slate earth palette.
assets.processing: Lanczos resize to 2048 RGB; raised-cosine seam correction over 96px edge bands, no mirroring or reference pixels; explicit sRGB chunk.
